 News › News News › MP Board Dummy Admit Card 2027 released! Check download link, correction deadline MP Board Dummy Admit Card 2027 released! Check download link, correction deadline
 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Nov 8, 2026, 09:58 IST MP Board Dummy Admit Card 2027 OUT: Check Download Link, Correction Deadline The Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education ( MPBSE ) released the MP Board Dummy Admit Card 2027 for Classes 10 and 12 . Students appearing for the MP Board exams 2027 can download their MPBSE dummy admit cards online through the official website mpbse.mponline.gov.in . The board has asked school principals to check the details mentioned on the dummy admit cards. 
 Students must also check their details and in case of any discrepancies should inform their schools. The last date to make corrections and submit the online declaration form is December 31, 2026. 
 MP Board dummy admit card 2027: Important dates
 Students can check the important dates related to the MP Board dummy admit card 2027 below.
 Event Date 
 Online declaration form submission started October 26, 2026 
 Dummy admit card released November 7, 2026 
 Last date for corrections and declaration form submission December 31, 2026 
 Steps to download MP Board dummy admit card 2027
 Students can follow the steps below to check their MP Board Class 10 and 12 dummy admit cards:
 Visit the official website at mpbse.mponline.gov.in 
 See for ' Main Exam Dummy Admit Card 2027' link
 Enter the application number or roll number
 The MP Board dummy admit card will appear on the screen
 Check the details and download it for future reference
 Details to check on MP Board Dummy Admit Card 2027
 After downloading the dummy admit card students should check all the details carefully. These are:
 Student's personal details
 Selected subjects
 Examination medium
 Other details filled in the examination application form
 If students find any mistakes they should contact their school authorities. 
 Schools can make the required changes online.
 MP Board dummy admit card 2027: Correction window
 MPBSE has asked schools to check the details mentioned on the dummy admit cards of Class 10 and 12 students. If students find any mistake in their details they should inform their respective school authorities for correction. Schools can make the required changes online by December 31, 2026.
 MP Board Class 10, 12 original admit card 2027 release date
 MPBSE shared that the original MPBSE admit cards for Class 10 and Class 12 board exams 2027 will be available only after the concerned school principal submits the online declaration form. Students should check their dummy admit cards and report any errors to their schools before the December 31, 2026 deadline. Students should also confirm that their school has completed the declaration form submission process.
